name: a-twin-pages
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design one final-quality macOS app icon concept for Bipara, a bilingual long-text reading and translation app. Square 1:1, one centered mark only, opaque full-bleed background to all four edges for later OS masking. Very minimal, memorable geometric symbol, professional Apple-native sensibility, impeccably balanced with generous 22% safe margins, readable at 32 pixels. Flat vector-like geometry with only restrained soft dimensional detail. No realistic book, no texture, no tiny details, no border, no surrounding tile or mockup, no watermark, no wordmark, no annotation. Concept A — Twin pages: exactly two tall slender ivory rounded rectangles side by side, a slim gap between, left subtly tilts inward 5 degrees and right subtly tilts inward 5 degrees to imply two facing pages. Each page has only one single short horizontal indigo line centered at the same height. Shape language is extremely clean and graphic. Saturated cornflower blue to indigo softly graduated background. Avoid ordinary open-book silhouettes; these are two simple vertical geometric page blocks.
